title: Chicco Polly High Chairs Recalled Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: Children can fall on or against the pegs on the rear legs of the high chair, resulting in a bruising or laceration injury. Units: About 455,000 in the United States and 30,690 in Canada.

title: Family Dollar Stores Recalls Decorative Light Sets Due To Fire and Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: The light sets do not meet the UL standard for this product and pose a fire and shock risk. Units: About 280,000.

title: Molenaar Recalls Folding Step Stools Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The folding step stools can break or collapse unexpectedly when in use, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,700.

title: Old Navy Recalls Toddler Girl Aqua Socks Due to Slip and Fall Hazard
summary: This style of Aqua Socks has less traction when worn on wet or smooth surfaces such as hardwood or tile, creating a slip and fall hazard. Units: About 34,000 in the U.S. and 3,800 in Canada.

title: Nikon Recalls Rechargeable Battery Packs Sold with Digital SLR Cameras Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The battery packs can short circuit, causing them to overheat and melt, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 5,100 in the United States, 1,100 in Canada and an additional 195,000 worldwide.

title: Troxel Recalls Flexible Flyer Swing Sets Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The see saw seats can break away from the bolt fasteners during use, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 100,500 in the United States and 4,900 in Canada.

title: Bosch Recalls SkilSaw Miter Saws Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The lower guard can break and contact the blade during use, posing a laceration hazard to users. Units: Approximately 22,149.

title: Bath Petals Recalls Soy Candles Due to Fire and Laceration Hazards
summary: The candle can burn with a high flame, causing excessive heat. This poses a fire hazard. The heat and flame can cause the glass candle holder to shatter. This poses a laceration hazard. Units: About 1,600 in the United States and 1,200 in Canada.

title: iSi North America Recalls Twist'n Sparkle Beverage Carbonation System Due to Explosion Hazard
summary: The plastic bottles can explode under pressure, expelling plastic parts, resulting in an injury hazard to anyone nearby. Units: About 162,700.

title: Innovage Recalls Discovery Kids Lamps Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The placement of internal wires near the circuit board can cause electrical short-circuiting and sparking, posing a fire and a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 300,000.

title: Motion Sensing Security Lights Recalled by HeathCo due to Electrical Shock Hazard Sold Exclusively at Home Depot
summary: Internal wiring can be damaged during installation, bulb replacement or adjustment, posing an electric shock hazard. Units: About 7,800.

title: Kolcraft Recalls Contours Tandem Strollers Due to Fall and Choking Hazards
summary: The front wheel assembly can break, posing a fall hazard to the child in the stroller. In addition, for strollers manufactured in January and February 2012, the nuts that hold the stroller's basket support screws in place can detach. Detached nuts can pose a choking hazard to young children. Units:

summary: Entrapment and strangulation can occur, especially to infants younger than 12 months of age, when a child is not harnessed. title: Burlington Coat Factory Recalls Power Strips Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The power strips have undersized wiring which poses a risk of shock to consumers. In addition, the wiring and plastic strip fail to meet fire resistance safety standards, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,000.

title: Children's Beach Chairs Recalled by Downeast Concepts Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The recalled children's beach chairs have exposed, sharp metal rivets, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 15,400.

title: Club Car Recalls Golf and Transport Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel hose can separate from the fuel tank, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 800.

title: Samuel Lawrence Furniture Expands Recall of Sleigh Beds Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The hardware holding the headboard and footboard can loosen or detach, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 2,400 in the United States and 100 in Canada. (This recall was first announced in June 2012).

title: Trampolines Recalled by Panline USA Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The handlebar can break, causing a fall hazard. Units: About 8,000.

title: TRUMPF Medical Systems Recalls Television Mounting System Due to Falling Hazard
summary: The arm joints on the television mounting system do not have a washer at the top joint which can result in excessive wear of the stop pins on the arm. This can allow the arm system and items connected to the arm to fall and injure the user or bystanders. Units: 215 distributed to 5 hospitals.

title: Green Toys Recalls Mini Vehicles Due To Choking Hazard
summary: The wheels and hubcaps on the toy cars can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 50,000 in the United States and 2,500 in Canada.

title: Liberty Mountain Recalls VAUDE Kenta Child Carriers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The side strap's seam can unravel and cause the strap to separate, posing a fall hazard to the child in the carrier. Units: About 300 in the United States and 100 in Canada.
